description: RFC 0001 R12: where the dedicated server's material facts are allowed to differ from a listen server's, each by name. The server reads material definitions without shaders, so a fact that a shader's parameter schema decides on a listen server cannot be reproduced.

deviations.reason: The ParticleSphere shader does not treat $basetexture (particle/SmokeStackFallback, 32x32) as a texture, so the listen server's representative texture is $bumpmap (particle/BillowNormalMap, 64x64). The server sizes sprites only for env_sprite bounds (CSprite::ComputeWorldSpaceSurroundingBox); this material is env_smokestack's particle, not an env_sprite.
